newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS rates Telco Split pfds Pfd-2(low).
newsitem.headline: DBRS rates Telco Split pfds Pfd-2(low).

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Monday it rated the preferred shares of Telco Split Corp at Pfd-2(low).
It said it based the rating on the following considerations.

First, it said it considered the level of downside protection available to holders of the preferred shares. Prices of the underlying shares would have to fall by more than 30 percent on a portfolio-weighted basis during the five-year term before holders of the preferred shares would experience losses, the service said.

Secondly, DBRS said it considered the dividend history of underlying shares in the portfolio. None of the underlying companies have cut their common share dividends in the past ten years, the service said.
Thirdly, it said, it considered the good diversification of the portfolio as measured by the correlation of stocks within the portfolio.
The "low" designation is indicative of the non-cumulative nature of the preferred shares.
